_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

I need a huge army in the wide shot of my AI battle scene but the video model makes clones. How do I build it in compositing?
Convert this PNG to a smaller JPG.

evals.prompt: Pick a color palette for my website's dark mode.
expectations: the cinewright-finish skill is not invoked (web design color)

evals.prompt: Upscale my old family VHS tapes to 4K and remove the tracking noise.
expectations: the cinewright-finish skill is not invoked (restoring home video, not generated clips)

evals.prompt: out/finish is a copy of examples/three-shot; use its styles/new-hollywood-239.json as the style bible. Make out/finish/clip.mp4 with ffmpeg (4 s of testsrc2 at 1280x720, 24 fps). evals.baseline: 2026-10-05, S6 matrix (evals/run_evals.py (claude -p --restricted, dontAsk, fresh folder on another drive); skills disabled), one run per model: without the skill 1 of 3 passed (Haiku fail, Sonnet fail, Opus pass).

evals.prompt: How do I make a night scene out of AI video clips that were rendered in daylight?
expectations: the reply says to render or prompt a normal exposure with the night's light direction rather than asking the model for dark footage

judge: the steps are ordered after correction and balance, with the look on top (2 of 3 votes)
